data.title: Esplora Residences
data.about:
Esplora by BNW Developments is a ready-to-move 20-storey residential tower nestled in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Dubai, one of the city’s fastest-growing communities. 

Designed to redefine urban sophistication, Esplora blends modern architecture, serene green spaces, and cutting-edge technology across 146 premium apartments, including studios, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom layouts.

Every detail, from its geometric façade to the Italian marble finishes, embodies comfort, elegance, and quality craftsmanship. 

With a completion timeline of 2026, this high-rise landmark serves as a testament to refined urban living in the heart of Dubai.

characteristics_module.title: Esplora by BNW Developments, redefining modern living with Italian elegance.
characteristics_module.heading: UNIQUE SELLING POINTS
characteristics_module.description:
• Designed for Modern Visionaries: Smart layouts blending technology, light, and space for contemporary living.
  • Italian-Inspired Elegance: Featuring Italian marble finishes and refined architectural detailing.
  • Life in the Heart of JVC: Enjoy quick access to parks, schools, and retail hubs in Dubai’s dynamic community.
  • Amenities that Redefine Lifestyle: From a veranda-style gym to a fire-pit courtyard, every space inspires a sense of balance.
  • Developer Excellence: Backed by BNW Developments, renowned for luxury craftsmanship and innovation.
  • Diverse Living Spaces: Choose from studios, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom layouts suited for professionals or families.
  • Secure Investment Value: Strong capital appreciation potential in a fast-growing Dubai district.
  • Seamless Payment Flexibility: Enjoy multiple plans, with only 10% due at booking and extended post-booking payments available.

location_tile.title: Esplora Residences JVC, The Pulse of Modern Dubai
location_tile.heading: Esplora Residences LOCATION
location_tile.description:
Located in JVC District 18, BNW Esplora Residences sits amid landscaped boulevards, retail promenades, and schools. 

JVC’s circular master plan offers a balance between city vibrancy and suburban calm. Residents enjoy quick access to Al Khail Road and Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Road, which connect them easily to Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and the Palm Jumeirah, offering a range of leisure and luxury options.

  • 9 Minutes – Circle Mall
  • 15 Minutes – Dubai Hills Estate
  • 18 Minutes – Mall of the Emirates
  • 21 Minutes – Dubai Marina
  • 22 Minutes – Palm Jumeirah
